actions.description: Engage every enabled control loop at the configured setpoint (native CONTROL)
actions.name: control_engage

actions.description: Disengage all control loops and disconnect the heaters (native STOP), the safe state
actions.name: control_stop

facts.text: The backend is for the Cryo-con Model 34 and its SCPI command set is shared across the Cryo-con family
A Model 34 has four input channels, A, B, C and D
Control loop 1 is the primary heater and is addressed as HEATER; loop 2 is AOUT
The channel display units are K, C, F and S
INPUT? reports in the channel's display units, not always Kelvin
The suite's Cryo-con variants verify that the chosen channel is displaying Kelvin before a run starts
set_setpoint_immediate validates 0 <= value <= 1000 in the loop's display units
CONTROL activates every enabled control loop; STOP disengages all loops and disconnects the heaters
control_stop writes STOP
get_control_status queries CONTROL? and reports ON or OFF
set_load accepts only 50 or 25 ohm
The loop control types are Off, PID, Man, Table and RampP
The loop control source is one of the input channels A, B, C and D
set_display_resolution accepts FULL, 1, 2 and 3
The selectable display filter time constants are 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64
set_display_time_constant sets the display filter time constant in seconds
set_input_name sets a custom name of at most 15 characters
set_factory_sensor_index accepts an index >= 0 and 0 disables the curve
reset sends *RST, a ~15 s hardware reset to power-up defaults; this driver does not expose it
disconnect only closes the VISA resource; it sends no *RST, no STOP and no loop, heater or setpoint change
The manual's example address for a Cryo-con 34 is GPIB1::23::INSTR

operator_required.name: setpoint
operator_required.reason: the clone validates 0 to 1000 in the loop's display units, but the safe setpoint depends on the cryostat and the sample; the site supplies the range

operator_required.name: max_power
operator_required.reason: the clone validates 0 to 100 percent of full scale, but the safe heater power depends on the cryostat and the sample; the site supplies the range

operator_required.name: max_setpoint
operator_required.reason: the clone validates 0 to 1000 K, but the highest setpoint the cryostat may use is a site decision; the site supplies it

operator_required.name: manual_power
operator_required.reason: the clone validates 0 to 100 percent of full scale, but manual heater power is a site hazard bound; the site supplies the range

safe_state.description: control loops disengaged and heaters disconnected (the native STOP command)
